report:
FLIGHT REPORT — Luminary 099, DSKY only, IMU unpowered. All values quoted as displayed.

CHECKPOINT 1 — AGC RESET (sec 0.1), V36E
Initial display on arrival: PROG "00", VERB blank, NOUN blank, R1/R2/R3 blank, no lamps.
Keyed V-3-6-ENTR. Display after ENTR: PROG blank, VERB blank, NOUN blank, R1/R2/R3 blank, no lamps.
Confirming read: PROG blank, VERB blank, NOUN blank, all registers blank, no lamps. Reset took: the AGC blanked PROG.

CHECKPOINT 2 — IDLE LOOP, PROG 00 CONFIRMED (sec 0.1), V37E 00E
Keyed V-3-7-ENTR: PROG blank, VERB "37", NOUN blank, registers blank.
Keyed 0-0: VERB "37", NOUN "00".
Display after final ENTR: PROG "00", VERB blank, NOUN blank, registers blank, lamp COMP ACTY lit.
Confirming read: PROG "00", VERB blank, NOUN blank, registers blank, no lamps.
PROG = 00 CONFIRMED on the first V37E 00E; no repeat needed.

CHECKPOINT 3 — LAMP TEST (sec 4.0), V35E
Display immediately after ENTR (pattern still filling): PROG "00", VERB "88", NOUN "88", R1 "+888  ", R2 blank, R3 blank; lamps lit: VEL, NO ATT, ALT, GIMBAL LOCK, TRACKER, PROG, UPLINK ACTY, TEMP, STBY, RESTART.
Full lamp-test pattern at peak (read 4 s later):
  DIGITS — PROG "88", VERB "88", NOUN "88", R1 "+88888", R2 "+88888", R3 "+88888" (every digit an 8, all three register signs showing "+").
  LAMPS (10 lit) — VEL, NO ATT, ALT, GIMBAL LOCK, TRACKER, PROG, UPLINK ACTY, TEMP, STBY, RESTART.
  COMP ACTY was NOT among the lamps lit during the test.
Let it end: after ~12 s all lamps were out and PROG had returned to "00", while VERB "88", NOUN "88" and R1/R2/R3 "+88888" remained latched on the digits. A further 10 s wait showed the same latched 88s with no lamps — the test had ended; the digit pattern persisted until overwritten by the next entry.

CHECKPOINT 4 — AGC CLOCK COUNTING, V16N36E
Keyed V-1-6-N-3-6-ENTR. Display right after ENTR (still filling): R1 "+00002", R2 "+88888", R3 "+88888".
READING ONE  (t=125.6): PROG "00", VERB "16", NOUN "36", R1 "+00002", R2 "+00013", R3 "+03037", no lamps.
READING TWO  (t=140.5, ~15 s later): PROG "00", VERB "16", NOUN "36", R1 "+00002", R2 "+00013", R3 "+04437", lamp COMP ACTY lit.
CONFIRMED COUNTING: R3 (100ths of a second) advanced +03037 -> +04437, i.e. 1400 hundredths = 14.00 s across a ~15 s wall interval. R1 (hours) held "+00002" and R2 (minutes) held "+00013"; clock read 2 h 13 min.

CHECKPOINT 5 — GIMBAL ANGLES (sec 1.6), V16N20E
While keying over the running V16N36 monitor the KEY REL lamp lit intermittently (on VERB press, on NOUN press, and after the "0" keystroke), clearing itself each time the next digit was accepted; it was out after the final ENTR. No OPR ERR occurred at any point in the flight, so no RSET was required.
Display after ENTR: PROG "00", VERB "16", NOUN "20", R1 "+00000", R2 "+00000", R3 "+00000", no lamps.
Confirming read 10 s later (steady, monitor still running): PROG "00", VERB "16", NOUN "20", R1 "+00000", R2 "+00000", R3 "+00000", no lamps.
THREE REGISTERS EXACTLY AS SHOWN:
  R1 (X-Gimbal / Outer / YAW)    = +00000
  R2 (Y-Gimbal / Inner / PITCH)  = +00000
  R3 (Z-Gimbal / Middle / ROLL)  = +00000
Note as observed, not inferred: with the IMU unpowered all three CDU angles read zero, and the NO ATT lamp was NOT lit during this monitor (it lit only as part of the V35 lamp test).

SUMMARY: Checkpoints 1-5 all completed in order. PROG 00 confirmed at idle; lamp test showed all-8s on PROG/VERB/NOUN/R1/R2/R3 plus the 10 caution-and-warning lamps listed above and then ended on its own; AGC clock confirmed running by two readings; gimbal angles all +00000. Final display state: V16 N20, PROG 00, R1/R2/R3 "+00000", monitor still active.
